title: Robust Lightweight Deep Learning Models for Oral Cancer Screening
abstract: arXiv:2608.21583v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Oral cancer is a leading cause of mortality in low-to-middle-income countries, where a shortage of specialists delays diagnosis. While point-of-care screening via smartphones offers a scalable solution, developing robust AI for resource-constrained settings poses significant challenges, including class imbalance in training data, variable data quality, and computational constraints on edge devices. In this paper, we present the optimisation of lightweight deep learning models for smartphone-based oral cancer screening. Using a diverse, multi-centre retrospective dataset of approximately 30,000 images acquired over a decade, we systematically evaluate state-of-the-art convolutional, transformer, and hybrid architectures. Through rigorous pipeline ablation, we demonstrate that directly optimising hybrid architectures for the edge strictly outperforms computationally heavy paradigms, such as large models or knowledge distillation. translated_title: 面向口腔癌筛查的稳健轻量级深度学习模型
translated_abstract: 口腔癌是中低收入国家的主要死亡原因，这些地区专家短缺导致诊断延误。虽然通过智能手机进行即时筛查提供了可扩展的解决方案，但在资源受限环境中开发稳健的人工智能面临重大挑战，包括训练数据中的类别不平衡、数据质量参差不齐以及边缘设备的计算限制。本文介绍了针对基于智能手机的口腔癌筛查的轻量级深度学习模型优化。使用一个包含约30,000张图像、跨越十年收集的多中心回顾性数据集，我们系统地评估了最先进的卷积、变换器和混合架构。通过严格的流程消融，我们证明直接优化面向边缘的混合架构严格优于计算密集型范式，如大型模型或知识蒸馏。
tldr: 本文通过优化轻量级混合深度学习架构，在资源受限的智能手机环境中实现了稳健的口腔癌筛查，并证明其优于计算密集型方法。
en_tdlr: This paper optimizes lightweight hybrid deep learning architectures for robust oral cancer screening on smartphones, demonstrating superiority over computationally heavy approaches in resource-constrained settings.
